question: Does the unfinished MOP project hold anything of value for the Ramanujan fork?
answer: Yes, and not where the owner expected. The substrate work does not transfer. The experimental-governance kernel does, and it fills a gap the Ramanujan specification does not currently name.
method: Read-only audit. MOP has 25 processes SIGSTOPped with unrecoverable in-RAM progress, so nothing was modified, no test was run, no process started. Verified afterwards: MOP working tree clean, all 25 still in T state, swap unchanged at 217.94 MB.

owner_hypothesis.stated: MOP is relevant because its whole thing is changing the way models think, moving away from LLM towards other inputs.
owner_hypothesis.why: Ramanujan's Director is a frozen LLM and its verifier is Lean. MOP's substrate line -- video/audio substrate, TinyVideoSubstrate, STARSS23 domain mathematics, moldable architectures, non-LLM representation learning -- answers a different question with a different success criterion. None of it becomes a mathematics engine.
owner_hypothesis.what_transfers_instead: The refusal system. MOP is, underneath the substrate research, a working apparatus for stopping a research loop from believing its own output.

verdict_distribution.comment: Zero as-is and seven no-overlap is the shape an honest cross-repo assessment should have between two projects that merely share vocabulary. Both use 'evidence', 'ledger', 'claim', 'budget', which is exactly how a false synergy gets manufactured.

claims_verified_directly_by_claude.claim: MOP refuses an experiment declaration that omits required fields
claims_verified_directly_by_claude.verified: src/mop/experiments/base.py:17 REQUIRED = {id, name, question, null_hypothesis, metrics, controls, source, split, unit, treatments, sesoi, multiplicity, ...}; line 50-52 raises RecordRefused on any missing field. A hard gate, not a warning.

claims_verified_directly_by_claude.claim: MOP classifies method failure before scientific failure
claims_verified_directly_by_claude.verified: src/mop/method/gate.py:128 classify_result runs an ordered sequence -- instrument_valid, bed_valid, mechanism_active, baseline_valid, estimator_sufficient -- BEFORE reading the scientific verdict, with the stated reason that 'a method failure makes the scientific question unanswered rather than answered in the negative'. This distinction is the difference between 'we tested it and it failed' and 'our test was broken', and a training loop that conflates them accumulates false negatives as signal.

claims_verified_directly_by_claude.claim: Prose cannot upgrade a sealed verdict
claims_verified_directly_by_claude.verified: src/mop/method/report.py:112 wording_check -- 'Prose may narrow or restate a sealed verdict. It may never broaden it.' Implements a verdict-strength lattice with negation-window handling. Ramanujan's spec states 'persuasive prose is not authority' as a principle; this is the executable mechanism.

claims_verified_directly_by_claude.claim: A reproduced defect outranks a panel vote
claims_verified_directly_by_claude.verified: src/mop/method/defects.py:251 adjudicate -- 'A reproduced defect is confirmed no matter how the panel voted. Votes only matter when nothing was reproduced, and even then they produce unresolved rather than refuted unless a reproduction attempt ran.' This is the Tribunal, and it is stronger than the Ramanujan spec: consensus cannot overturn reproduction.

why_this_matters_specifically_for_ramanu: Ramanujan's F4-F9 arc is expert iteration, preference training, and bounded verifier-guided reinforcement learning. Those are precisely the regimes in which a system generates its own training data, grades it with its own judge, and drifts. Self-deception is the default outcome, not the failure case. The Ramanujan specification names the governance GOALS -- roles cannot promote their own claims, the system never certifies its own novelty, the Tribunal controls admissibility -- but not the machinery that enforces them. MOP has the machinery, already debugged against real runs.
gaps_in_the_ramanujan_spec_that_mop_woul: SESOI and powered nulls -- without a smallest effect of interest, an RL or expert-iteration bump is uninterpretable and an unpowered null gets misread as a method failure
Multiplicity policy -- F0-F9 plus checkpoint tournaments generate many comparisons; uncontrolled multiplicity manufactures false positives by construction
Stop rules and sealed continuation -- prevents one-more-seed and one-more-RL-run after peeking
Default claim ceilings forced false until external confirmation
Producer/verifier separation enforced structurally by import boundary rather than by honour system
Nulls and negatives as first-class outputs -- a training arc that discards nulls retrains on survivorship, and the Graveyard needs null strategies
Quantity provenance kinds -- tags a number as measured versus structurally guaranteed, so a construction-true metric cannot be presented as a finding
Defect ledger with mutation reinjection -- past self-fools become permanent regressions
Pre-principal cheap gates -- refuse an invalid instrument, bed or power before burning Lean or GPU hours
Arm distinctness by execution trace -- prevents named ablations that secretly share an implementation
Value-of-information queue that refuses closed premises -- stops re-running directions already null-closed, which maps onto Strategy and Graveyard
recommended_fork_surface: src/mop/method/ -- contracts, gate, defects, acceptance, power, report, arms, hypothesis, voi
src/mop/experiments/base.py -- the REQUIRED declaration set and RecordRefused
the STARSS23 producer/verifier separation as DOCUMENTATION of the pattern, not as code
must_not_carry_over: src/mop/substrate, forge/, frontier/, campaign2/ -- domain-scoped to MOP's own research question
STARSS23 domain mathematics -- a spatial-audio bed, not a mathematics bed

Collapsed packages as dependencies: src/mop/falsification, mechanisms, ladder, perspectives and learning exist as __pycache__ bytecode only. Per MOP's own ARCHITECTURE.md their source is content-addressed in MOP_COLLAPSE_STATE.json and not maintained beside current implementations. They are not forkable as source without recovering from that collapse state first.
practical_note: MOP being unfinished and currently paused does not block this. The governance kernel is standalone -- it does not depend on MOP's substrate research reaching a conclusion -- so the value transfers even if MOP never completes.
scheduling: Assessment only. Ramanujan is Continuum step 14, gated behind HAWKING_EVOLUTION_COMPLETE. Nothing is being forked now; this exists so that when step 14 arrives the decision is already made and evidenced.
not_evidence_of: that the ported kernel works in a mathematics domain, or that MOP's own scientific conclusions are correct
